entities.summary: Nora AlMatrooshi is the first Emirati and Arab woman astronaut, selected as part of the second batch of the UAE Astronaut Programme. In 2024, she graduated from the NASA astronaut candidate class training program and received her astronaut pin, establishing her as a fully qualified astronaut prepared for future space missions.
